episode_title: Write a Book That Gets You Booked | Taurea Avant

real_qa.q: Why should entrepreneurs write a book instead of trying to sell books directly?
real_qa.r: The biggest mistake authors make is writing a book to sell a book versus writing a book to sell. You should write a book as a marketing tool for transformation and movement, not just to move copies. When you create a book, you have to think bigger than just selling the book itself. The book becomes a tool to get in front of audiences, secure speaking engagements, attract coaching clients, or promote a product or service. For example, one author uses her book about healthy relationships and social media to get into schools and the YMCA to speak and promote her app for neurodivergent children.
real_qa.requete: write book to sell product service not book

real_qa.q: How do you know if you have written the right book for your business?
real_qa.r: The way you know if you wrote the right book is if you go to an event, set it up, and people who don't know you are buying it. Most people don't care about your memoir or biography unless you're already famous. Instead, people are looking for solutions to what they're overcoming—depression, heartbreak, diabetes, workplace disrespect. You have to put yourself in the mindset of the reader and create a book that solves their problem. If you set your book down at an event and nobody is picking it up or wanting to buy it, then you need to adjust what the book is about.
real_qa.requete: how to know if book topic will sell

real_qa.q: What is the Vision Impact Network that Toria Vision Avant recently launched?
real_qa.r: The Vision Impact Network is an OTT (Over-The-Top) network where creators can launch their own show and have it streamed on the network. It is designed for people who are using their words to impact the world. Her goal is to get the first 20 plus shows live on the network by the end of the year, providing visibility opportunities for authors, speakers, and coaches to grow their influence and reach larger audiences.

real_qa.q: How can you use a book to get booked as a speaker at conferences?
real_qa.r: Instead of just messaging a conference organizer, you can send them a copy of your book along with a message saying you want to be a speaker at their event. This gives you the opportunity to speak in front of hundreds or possibly thousands of people who can become buyers of your book. By getting in front of one decision maker with your book, you open the opportunity to speak in front of more people and build your speaking platform.
real_qa.requete: use book to get speaking engagements conferences

real_qa.q: What personal experience led Toria Vision Avant to focus on helping authors and speakers?
real_qa.r: After her father passed away from stage four lung cancer, Toria realized how short life truly is and committed to stop quitting ventures and stick with something meaningful. She began with a website design company, then moved into network marketing and coffee businesses where she learned about sales, coaching, and teaching. When she wrote her first book, doors opened unexpectedly—organizations asked her to teach goal-setting, vision boards, and leadership based on what she had written. This realization that sharing expertise through a book could open speaking and coaching opportunities became the foundation of her mission to help other entrepreneurs do the same.
